'''H-Delta Squadron''' was a [[TIE/ad starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service of the [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|fleet]] of renegade [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]], who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. H-Delta Squadron took part in [[Battle at DS 5|defending]] Rebel outpost [[DS 5]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but ultimately their efforts proved to be futile. Admiral Harkov was captured, and all fighters were destroyed.
